title: Construction Lessons
eyebrow: Owner's course in building from the ground up
sub: An eight-week course in how a building is procured, priced, financed and built from the contract to the ground slab, taught from the owner's seat.
about:
This course follows a hypothetical mid-rise apartment building from the delivery decision through contracts, cost and programme, site investigation, excavation, temporary works, foundations and the ground slab, with the financing questions a lender and an equity partner ask at each step. Every number in it is a round hypothetical chosen to teach a method; none describes a real project.

Each week has four teaching days and a Friday review. Codes and standards are taught against American practice (IBC, ACI, ASCE, OSHA, NFPA, ASTM); any clause or figure not checked against the current adopted edition is marked as unverified. Nothing here is legal, engineering, tax or financing advice; each lesson names the licensed professional a real decision needs.

weekTitles.8: Wet ground, the mat pour and the ground slab
